# Test fixtures

Synthetic `openspec/` trees written for the test suite. They are NOT copied from any real repository: names, dates and
content are made up. Never copy a real project's `openspec/` directory in here — this repository may be public.
Tests assert on the structure of these trees, so change them together with the tests.
- `demo-ops/openspec/changes/trim-log-noise` has a proposal, specs and open tasks but no design: `Ready`, because the
  spec-driven schema requires only `tasks` before implementing.
